clue.text: Be provoked to complain, implying "Get stuffed!"

explanation.surface: Someone told rudely to get stuffed has every reason to grumble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Get stuffed!' is a rude British brush-off, but here it is read literally as eating far too much.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means having endured as much as one can stand, and literally means a stomach filled to capacity.

clue.text: Gas provides volatile, yet clean, energy

clue.text: Master of Ceremonies has become more expansive, after being taken short!

clue.text: Have faith in credit

clue.text: As a matter of pride, perhaps, expecting more than anyone else

clue.text: Tired with this, suggested getting drunk?

clue.text: Pained expression recalled: "I seem undone!"

clue.text: Be specific, identifying at least three celebrities
